Sidebar

Vertically displayed navigation bar for switching between different content areas (minimum version: 24.9.0)

Sample Code

Basic Usage

Control the selection by setting the activeKey property on maui-sidebar.


<maui-sidebar active-key='{{ activeKey }}'>
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name' />
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name' />
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name' />
</maui-sidebar>

Page({
  data: {
    activeKey: 0,
  },
});

Info Tips

After setting the dot attribute, a small red dot will be displayed in the upper right corner. After setting the info attribute, the corresponding logo will be displayed in the upper right corner.


<maui-sidebar active-key='{{ activeKey }}'>
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name' dot />
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name' info='5' />
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name' info='99+' />
</maui-sidebar>

Disable Option

Disable options via the disabled attribute.


<maui-sidebar active-key='{{ activeKey }}'>
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name' />
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name' disabled />
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name' />
</maui-sidebar>

Listen for Switching Events

Set up the change method to listen for events when switching navigation items.


<maui-sidebar active-key='{{ activeKey }}' bindchange='onChange'>
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name 1' />
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name 2' />
  <maui-sidebar-item title='tag name 3' />
</maui-sidebar>

Page({
  data: {
    activeKey: 0,
  },
  onChange({ detail }) {
    console.log(detail)
  }
});

API

Sidebar Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
activeKey index of selected item String | Number 0

Sidebar Event

Event Name Description Parameter
change Triggered when switching badges The index of the currently selected badge

SidebarItem Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
title content String ''
dot Whether to display the small red dot in the upper right corner Boolean false
info The content of the logo in the upper right corner of the icon String | Number ''
disabled Whether to disable this item Boolean false

SidebarItem Slot

Name Description
- Customize the title bar. If the title attribute is set, it will not take effect.

SidebarItem Event

Event Name Description Parameter
bindclick Fires when the info is clicked event.detail is the index of the current info
